description: Terminal-based Snake game in Python using curses library

userStories.title: Create project structure and curses game window
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to set up the snake game project with a curses-based terminal window that draws a bordered game grid.
acceptanceCriteria: Create snake/ directory with __init__.py and snake.py
snake.py initializes curses, sets up a game window with a bordered grid (minimum 20x20 cells)
Main game loop runs and refreshes the window
python -m py_compile snake/snake.py exits with code 0

userStories.title: Implement snake rendering and movement
userStories.description: As a player, the snake should be visible on the grid and move in a direction each game tick.
acceptanceCriteria: Snake represented as a list of (row, col) segments starting at grid center
Initial length is 3 segments
Head rendered as 'O', body as 'o'
Snake moves forward one cell per game tick
The game loop runs at a fixed interval (e.g., 150ms per tick)
python -m py_compile snake/snake.py exits with code 0

userStories.title: Add arrow key controls
userStories.description: As a player, I want to change the snake's direction using arrow keys.
acceptanceCriteria: Arrow keys (UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT) change snake direction
Snake cannot reverse into itself (pressing opposite direction is ignored)
Only one direction change per game tick (no 180 on the same tick)
curses keypad mode enabled for arrow key input
python -m py_compile snake/snake.py exits with code 0

userStories.title: Add food spawning and growth mechanics
userStories.description: As a player, food should appear on the grid and the snake should grow when eating it.
acceptanceCriteria: Food spawns at a random empty position (not on snake body)
Food rendered as a distinct character (e.g., '$')
When snake head reaches the food cell, snake grows by 1 segment
A new food spawns immediately after the previous one is eaten
python -m py_compile snake/snake.py exits with code 0

userStories.title: Add collision detection and game over
userStories.description: As a player, the game should end when the snake hits a wall or itself.
acceptanceCriteria: Snake head hitting the wall boundary triggers game over
Snake head hitting its own body triggers game over
Game over shows a message on screen for 2 seconds then exits

userStories.description: As a player, I want to see my score during gameplay and on the game over screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Score displayed at the top of the window, incremented by 10 per food eaten
Game over screen shows 'Game Over! Final Score: X'
